standards.name: Child Development and Learning in Context
standards.description: Understanding how children grow and learn within their families, cultures, communities, and individual circumstances.

standards.name: Family–Teacher Partnerships and Community Connections
standards.description: Building respectful, reciprocal relationships with families and connecting children’s learning with their communities.

standards.name: Child Observation, Documentation, and Assessment
standards.description: Using purposeful observation and documentation to understand development and inform responsive teaching.

standards.name: Developmentally, Culturally, and Linguistically Appropriate Teaching Practices
standards.description: Choosing teaching approaches that respond to children’s development, strengths, experiences, languages, and interests.

standards.name: Knowledge, Application, and Integration of Academic Content in the Early Childhood Curriculum
standards.description: Creating meaningful opportunities for children to explore ideas, build knowledge, and make connections through learning experiences.

standards.name: Professionalism as an Early Childhood Educator
standards.description: Reflecting on professional responsibilities, ethical practice, collaboration, and continued growth as an educator.
